description: Captures the deterministic state evolution while the reference DOOM 1.9 plays back the DEMO2 lump from doom/DOOM1.WAD. DEMO2 is the second attract-loop demo. State hashes per 02-012 and framebuffer hashes per 02-011 are captured at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at the demo end. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Launch DOOM.EXE; after DEMO1 finishes, allow DEMO2 to auto-play; capture state + framebuffer at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at demo end.
